customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

name.meaning: full name of the account holder (for an organization, the authorized contact) as on the agreement

customer_type.meaning: customer segment of the profile; decides which subscription lines and waitlist classes the customer may hold

business_name.meaning: legal name of the business, farm or organization; empty for residential customers

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the account holder or authorized contact

customer_since.meaning: date the customer profile was opened

utility_account_id.meaning: primary id of the utility account record

customer_id.meaning: customer in whose name the utility account is held (foreign key -> customers)

account_number.meaning: utility account number exactly as printed on the utility bill

rate_class.meaning: utility rate class of the account

account_status.meaning: utility-reported status: active, or final_billed after the holder closed service

final_bill_date.meaning: date the utility issued the final bill; empty while active

annual_usage_kwh.meaning: utility-reported consumption over the twelve months ending usage_as_of_month

data_authorization_date.meaning: date the holder authorized release of utility data to Meadowlark; empty when none is on file

assistance_program_enrolled.meaning: utility-reported enrollment of the account in a utility bill-assistance program

designated_community.meaning: state or program designation of the service address's community

project_id.meaning: primary id of the community solar project

program.meaning: state program the project is built under: NY_VDER (New York Community Distributed Generation, Value Stack), MN_CSG (Xcel Energy Solar*Rewards Community, Minnesota), IL_SHINES (Illinois Shines community solar), MD_CS (Maryland Community Solar)

utility.meaning: utility whose customers the project credits

expected_yield_kwh_per_kw.format: kWh per kW AC per year, whole number
expected_yield_kwh_per_kw.meaning: expected annual production per kW of share used for sizing, guarantees and estimates

est_credit_rate_per_kwh.meaning: Meadowlark's published estimate of the project's average bill credit rate, used only for offer estimates and deposits

unallocated_kw.format: kW AC, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more
unallocated_kw.meaning: capacity not allocated to any subscriber as of the latest allocation filing

commercial_operation_date.meaning: date the project began operating; empty while under construction

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>'
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>'

home_sub_id.meaning: primary id of the Residential Community Solar Subscriptions subscription agreement

variant_name.meaning: the plan held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the subscription (states defined in the charter lifecycle)

project_id.meaning: the community solar project the share is allocated from (foreign key -> projects)

utility_account_id.meaning: the utility account the bill credits are allocated to (foreign key -> utility_accounts); after a completed move transfer it is the new account

contract_kw.meaning: share size written in the signed agreement at enrollment; later allocation changes are recorded as filings and never rewrite it

allocation_kw.meaning: share currently filed with the utility: identically the sum of this subscription's allocation filings (filed minus reduced; reassignments do not change it); 0.00 until the initial filing and after the removal filing

billing_type.meaning: how the subscriber is billed: consolidated = the utility nets the subscription charge on its own bill (net crediting); dual = Meadowlark invoices the subscription charge separately

sales_channel.meaning: channel through which the agreement was signed; door_to_door means signed at the subscriber's home or premises with a sales representative present

signed_date.meaning: date the subscriber signed the agreement

approved_date.meaning: date Meadowlark approved the utility-data review and submitted the initial allocation filing; empty until approved

activation_date.meaning: posting date of the first bill credit statement on this subscription; empty until active; contract years run from this date

term_end_date.meaning: last day of the committed term (activation_date plus the plan's term_months, less one day); empty for plans without a term

notice_date.meaning: date Meadowlark received the subscriber's cancellation notice; empty when no notice is pending

scheduled_end_date.meaning: effective date of the allocation removal filing scheduled by a cancellation notice; empty when no notice is pending

move_out_date.meaning: move-out date the subscriber stated for a move transfer; empty when no transfer is pending or after it completes

pending_utility_account_id.meaning: new utility account named in a pending move transfer (foreign key -> utility_accounts); empty when none is pending

removal_notice_date.meaning: date Meadowlark sent a nonpayment removal notice; empty when none is outstanding

closed_date.meaning: date the subscription closed; empty while open

closure_reason.meaning: why the subscription closed; not_closed while the subscription is open

home_filing_id.meaning: primary id of the allocation filing line

home_sub_id.meaning: subscription the filing line belongs to

utility_account_id.meaning: utility account this filing line applies to (for a reassignment, the receiving account)

kw.format: kW AC, 2 decimal places, always greater than 0.00
kw.meaning: kW this filing line adds (filed), removes (reduced) or moves to another utility account (reassigned); never signed, never 0.00

filing_month.meaning: calendar month in which Meadowlark submitted the allocation schedule containing this line

effective_date.meaning: first day of the month the utility applies the line from, per the filing calendar

filing_reason.meaning: business reason for the filing line

home_request_id.meaning: subscriber request the line carries out (foreign key -> requests); empty for company-initiated lines

home_credit_id.meaning: primary id of the bill credit statement line

home_sub_id.meaning: subscription the credits were allocated under

utility_account_id.meaning: utility account the utility posted (or reversed) the credit on

statement_month.meaning: utility billing month the credit statement belongs to

credited_kwh.meaning: kWh of project output the utility credited for this statement (for a reversal, the kWh reversed)

credit_value.meaning: dollar value of the bill credit as calculated and reported by the utility (Value Stack, bill credit rate or supply credit, by program); always positive, direction given by the family

banked_value.meaning: portion of credit_value the utility could not apply to that month's utility bill and carried forward on the utility account; 0.00 when fully applied; 0.00 on reversals

posted_date.meaning: date the utility reported the posting or reversal to Meadowlark

home_reversed_credit_id.meaning: for a reversal, the credit statement line it reverses (same table); empty on postings

home_bill_id.meaning: primary id of the billing ledger line

amount.meaning: amount of the line; always positive — charges, fees and returned payments raise the balance, payments and billing credits lower it, per the family

bill_date.meaning: invoice date for charges and fees; receipt date for payments; posting date for returns and credits

billing_month.meaning: statement month the line belongs to (for a charge, the statement month of the credit it prices)

due_date.meaning: payment due date of a charge or fee; empty on payments and credits

home_credit_id.meaning: bill credit statement a subscription charge prices or a reversal correction offsets (foreign key -> credits); empty otherwise

home_ref_bill_id.meaning: ledger line this line refers to: the overdue charge for a late fee, the payment for a return or returned-payment fee, the charge or fee a billing credit corrects; empty otherwise

charge_basis.meaning: for a subscription charge, whether it prices a posted credit (actual) or an estimate made while the utility statement was late; not_applicable on every other line

billing_type.meaning: billing arrangement in force on the line's bill_date

payment_method.meaning: how a payment was made (utility_remittance = paid through the utility under consolidated billing); not_applicable on non-payment lines

credit_reason.meaning: reason for a billing credit; not_applicable on every other line

home_review_id.meaning: primary id of the annual true-up record

contract_year.meaning: contract year closed by this review (year 1 ends on the first anniversary of activation_date)

period_start_month.meaning: first statement month of the twelve reviewed

period_end_month.meaning: last statement month of the twelve reviewed

credited_kwh_12m.meaning: net kWh credited over the period (postings less reversals)

usage_kwh_12m.meaning: utility-reported consumption of the utility account over the same twelve months

guaranteed_kwh.meaning: kWh the plan's production guarantee assures for the period; 0 for plans without a guarantee

shortfall_kwh.meaning: guaranteed_kwh less credited_kwh_12m when positive, else 0

avg_credit_rate.meaning: net credit value over the period divided by credited_kwh_12m

guarantee_credit.meaning: production-guarantee credit owed by this review; 0.00 when none is owed

resize_kw.format: kW AC, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more
resize_kw.meaning: kW the review removes to right-size the share; 0.00 when no resize

home_request_id.meaning: primary id of the subscriber request

requested_kw.meaning: kW to add or remove for an allocation change; 0.00 for every other request type

new_utility_account_id.meaning: utility account named for a move transfer or a successor transfer (foreign key -> utility_accounts); empty otherwise

move_out_date.meaning: move-out date stated for a move transfer; empty otherwise

home_disputed_bill_id.meaning: ledger line disputed by a billing dispute (foreign key -> billing); empty otherwise

received_date.meaning: date Meadowlark received the request; the anchor for filing-calendar and notice counting

effective_date.meaning: date the request takes effect per the filing calendar or notice rules; empty until decided

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>'
